subject: deployment_lifecycle
correlation_obligations: Execute the lifecycle artifact against AWS and require post-destroy inventory to show no stack resources, distribution, VPC-origin ENI, image repository, or pending secret.
Each synthesized template is at most 51,200 bytes and contains no bootstrap reference, asset manifest, custom hostname, ACM certificate, or staging bucket.

The normal order is edge then zero-task workload then immutable image push then two-task workload; teardown reverses it. If the reviewed size fallback is activated, use network then distribution then workload and reverse that order.
